## Counsellor's pick
**Applied-AI Engineer at AI-first product companies.** It's where the rare combination — production cloud depth + shipped AI tooling — compounds. Honest gap: no big-brand name yet; close it with one flagship open-source AI project + a focused interview-prep sprint. 6–12 month sequence: polish OSS → tune profile for inbound → referral-led applications.
